Ishan Kishan Tops ICC T20I Batting Rankings

Cricketer Ishan Kishan has achieved the world number one position in the ICC T20I batting rankings. He has overtaken Abhishek Sharma to secure this top spot. The rankings reflect current player performance in the T20 international format.
